limitations_and_boundaries: In vitro experiments using primary microglia may not fully recapitulate in vivo microglial states.
Ab oligomer 40-S26C dimer may not represent all Ab species in AD.
Human postmortem tissue may have postmortem artifacts.
TREM2 R47H variant is a loss-of-function mutation; other TREM2 variants may have different effects.

research_questions.statement: What is the molecular mechanism by which microglia selectively engulf synapses in Alzheimer's disease models?

provenance.text_excerpt: Our work supports that microglia remove hyperactive ePtdSer+ synapses in Ab-relevant context and suggest a potential beneficial role for microglia in the earliest stages of AD.

claims.statement: Microglia-synapse engulfment via ePtdSer-TREM2 is a beneficial mechanism that resolves neuronal hyperactivity in early AD.

additional_provenance.text_excerpt: We hypothesized that local synaptic ePtdSer underlies the vulnerability of synapses to microglial engulfment via TREM2.

provenance.text_excerpt: These apoptotic-like spines are targeted by microglia for engulfment via TREM2 leading to amelioration of Ab oligomer-induced synaptic hyperactivity.

claims.statement: Microglia preferentially engulf Ab oligomer-bound synaptosomes via recognition of externalized phosphatidylserine (ePtdSer) by TREM2.

additional_provenance.text_excerpt: in TREM2 dysfunctional microglia where recognition of ePtdSer is impaired (Wang et al, 2015), microglia no longer preferentially engulf Ab+ synapses in vitro despite normal phagocytic activity

provenance.text_excerpt: Higher levels of apoptotic-like synapses in mice as well as humans that carry TREM2 loss-of-function variants were also observed.

claims.statement: In TREM2 dysfunctional microglia, recognition of ePtdSer is impaired, leading to reduced engulfment of Ab+ synapses and accumulation of apoptotic-like synapses.

methods.name: In vitro synaptosome engulfment assay
methods.protocol_description: Primary microglia from C57BL6/J WT mice supplemented with mCSF1, TGF-b1, and CX3CL1. Synaptosomes conjugated to pHrodo dyes (red or deep red) and added to microglia. Fluorescence measured over time. Annexin-V pretreatment used to block ePtdSer.

methods.name: Ab oligomer treatment
methods.protocol_description: Synthetic humanized Ab oligomer 40-S26C dimer (50 nM) applied to primary cultures or fresh synaptosomes for 1 h at 37°C, 5% CO2.

methods.name: In vivo PSVue injection
methods.protocol_description: PSVue (1.5 µl) injected bilaterally into lateral ventricles of anesthetized mice (coordinates: 0.5 mm A/P, 1.0 mm lateral, 2.3 mm D/V from bregma) at 0.3 µl/min. Mice perfused 24 h post-injection.

methods.name: Crude synaptosome preparation
methods.protocol_description: Tissue homogenized in sucrose buffer, centrifuged at 3,000g and 14,000g, resuspended in Percoll gradient, and synaptosomal fraction recovered. Protein quantified by BCA assay.

methods.name: Immunocytochemistry (ICC)
methods.protocol_description: Cells/synaptosomes fixed in 4% PFA/4% sucrose, permeabilized with 0.25% Triton X-100, blocked with 10% BSA, incubated with primary antibodies (1/1000) overnight at 4°C, then secondary antibodies (1/1000) for 1 h at RT.

methods.name: In vivo microglial engulfment imaging and analysis
methods.protocol_description: Confocal microscopy (Zeiss LSM 800, 63x, 2048x2048, 11 µm Z-stack). Imaris 3D surface rendering: P2Y12 surface, CD68 masked to P2Y12, Homer1 masked to CD68. Engulfment index = (volume of Homer1 in CD68 / microglial cell volume) * 100.

methods.name: Super-resolution imaging and analysis
methods.protocol_description: Airyscan (Zeiss LSM 880, 63x, 1.4NA, 2048x2048, Z-step 144 nm) or STED (Leica Stellaris, 100x, 1.4NA, 2048x2048, Z-step 200 nm). Imaris spot detection for pre- and postsynaptic puncta, colocalization distance 0.25 µm.
